description: Lists the saved models and runs you deleted that can still be restored, the one whose restore window closes soonest first. Use this when the user wants back something they deleted, to find its id for restore_deleted, or asks what can still be recovered. A deleted item can be restored for 30 days after it was deleted; after that it no longer appears here and is gone for good. It returns one entry per item with its kind (graph or run), its id, its name when it has one, when it was deleted and the time after which it can no longer be restored, plus next_offset when there are more to page through. Pass kind to list only graphs or only runs. When a saved model is deleted its runs go with it, and restoring the model brings them back. It needs a Neumann account: send your key, or your signed-in token, in the Authorization header as a Bearer credential. No Neumann tool takes an api_key argument. Example: {"limit":20,"offset":0} Cost: free -- it debits no credits and spends none of your free daily runs -- but it needs an account; an anonymous caller gets account_required.

kind.description: Optional. graph to list only deleted models, run to list only deleted runs. Omit it for both.
kind.title: Kind

limit.description: How many items to return, the one whose restore window closes soonest first.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: How many items to skip, for paging. Use the next_offset the previous call returned.
